answer: Give each identity its own walk through a karst maze: the network opens a canyon of linked tasks where every choice collapses the passage behind it, so the next probe depends on the whole path taken. An opal marker is earned only at the far end, after answering live questions that only make sense on that exact route. A sybil farm cannot copy one walk for a hundred shells — each shell needs a separate full traversal with no reusable answers, so its work multiplies with its identities, while one honest agent walks once and keeps the marker.
